$comment: C5.7a (DELIVERY_REVIEW.md C11). Written by workflow/run_phase1_research.py::_build_idea_status_artifact and saved through save_yaml (artifacts/idea_status.yaml), which checks it against this file by stem -- warn-only by default, blocking only under WORKFLOW_ARTIFACT_VALIDATION=raise (tools/workflow_artifact_validation.py, the same hook as every schema in this directory). Only orchestrator.grid_evaluation.enabled writes it. Every field is code-written from the grid (never LLM-authored), so this schema is closed (additionalProperties: false). The three (result, hypothesis_verdict, lineage_routing) triples are _GRID_IDEA_STATUS_ROUTING verbatim and are pinned to their idea_status below; a grid whose idea_status is None (SPEC_ERROR) never reaches this artifact (the builder raises). The only permissive field is `reason`, which the builder copies with .get() and may therefore be null.
title: runs/<run>/artifacts/idea_status.yaml
description: The grid's idea-level status for one run, in the shape pass_rule_evaluation.yaml uses when it carries a binding verdict. The single source of the idea's status (validated / refuted / inconclusive).

grid_evaluation_ref.description: runs/<run_id>/artifacts/grid_evaluation.yaml -- the grid this status was rolled up from.
